title: Purchasing and Property Management
summary: This proposed rule revises the Legal Services Corporation's (LSC) definition of "capital improvement" by removing the threshold amount of LSC funds that must be expended on an improvement to real estate for the expenditure to qualify as a capital improvement. The proposed amendment would distinguish the definition of a capital improvement from the monetary thresholds required for prior approval; promote consistent tracking and oversight of LSC funds used for capital improvements; and strengthen accountability for LSC funds invested in recipients' real property.

title: Cost Standards and Procedures; Purchasing and Property Management
summary: This final rule revises the Legal Services Corporation's (LSC or Corporation) regulations governing cost allowability, prior approval requirements, and property and procurement standards applicable to LSC recipients. The final rule clarifies when recipients must obtain prior approval for expenditures of LSC funds; increases the monetary threshold for prior approval; clarifies the treatment of proceeds from fundraising activities supported with LSC funds; provides additional flexibility in LSC's review of prior approval requests; clarifies documentation requirements for prior approval requests; and revises the deadline and requirements for accounting for LSC funds invested in real estate. These amendments are intended to clarify existing requirements, reduce administrative burden, promote consistent oversight and enforcement, and strengthen accountability in the use of Federal funds.

summary: The FAA proposes to adopt a new airworthiness directive (AD) for certain Airbus SAS Model A318-111 and -112 airplanes; Model A319- 111, -112, -113, -114, -115, -131, -132, and -133 airplanes; Model A320-211, -212, -214, -216, -231, -232, and -233 airplanes; and Model A321-111, -112, -131, -211, -212, -213, -231, and -232 airplanes. This proposed AD was prompted by reports of damage to the YZ-axis attachment points on airplanes equipped with certain overhead stowage compartments (OHSC) bins. Investigations showed that bushings, retainer rings, and pins had migrated from their original positions. This proposed AD would require a one-time inspection for discrepancies of affected OHSC bins and, depending on findings, accomplishment of applicable corrective actions. This proposed AD would also prohibit the installation of affected parts. The FAA is proposing this AD to address the unsafe condition on these products.

title: Scotts Valley Band of Pomo Indians of California Liquor Control Ordinance; Correction
summary: This notice publishes several corrections to the Scotts Valley Band of Pomo Indians of California Liquor Control Ordinance, as amended, published on June 1, 2026. The Tribe requested that the Bureau of Indian Affairs make three corrections to typographical errors it identified in its original Ordinance submission that was previously published in the Federal Register. First, Article I, Section 3 mistakenly identifies the Tribe's trust land as being in "Vallejo County"; the correct geographic description is "the City of Vallejo, Solano County, California." Second, Article I, Section 3(v) incorrectly uses the term "Indian county" instead of the correct statutory term "Indian country" as used in 18 U.S.C. 1154 and 1161. Third, Article VII, Section 1 contains a typographical error referring to "uncontested suits or actions"; the correct phrase is "unconsented suits or actions," accurately reflecting the Tribe's intent to preserve its sovereign immunity.

title: Underwriting Auction for sale of Government Securities for ₹36,000 crore on November 06, 2026
summary: Government of India has announced the sale (re-issue) of Government Securities, as detailed below, through auction to be held on November 06, 2026 (Friday) . As per the extant scheme of underwriting commitment notified on November 14, 2007, the amounts of Minimum Underwriting Commitment (MUC) and the minimum bidding commitment under Additional Competitive Underwriting (ACU) auction, applicable to each Primary Dealer (PD), are as under: (₹ crore) Security Notified Amount MUC amount per PD Minimum bidding commitment per PD under ACU auction 7.06% GS 2041 23,000 548 548 7.43% GS 2076 13,000 310 310 The underwriting auction will be conducted through multiple price-based method on November 06, 2026 (Friday) . PDs may submit their bids for ACU auction electronically through Reserve Bank of India’s Core Banking Solution (e-Kuber system) between 09:00 A.M. and 09:30 A.M. on the day of underwriting auction. The underwriting commission will be credited to the current account of the respective PDs with RBI on the day of issue of securities.
